```{r}
# Directory containing the job directory or directories you generated
# (e.g., if you ran multiple jobs and stored their outputs in the same parent directory).
# This should be the parent directory of the directory named by `slug`.
rootdir <- "/path/to/parent/directory/"

# Name of the specific job directory to process.
slug <- "my_job_name"

# Number of virtual machines
n_machines <- 12

# Matrix shapes files from each VM
shapes_files <- file.path(
  rootdir,
  slug,
  paste0("mm-worker-", seq_len(n_machines)),
  "matrix_shapes.json"
)

# Outcomes below resolution limit
outcomes_below_resolution_limit_file <- file.path(
  rootdir,
  slug,
  "parsed",
  paste0(slug, "_outcomes_below_resolution_limit.csv")
)
```

# Read and prep files

```{r}
read_prep_json <- function(shapes_filename) {
  js <- fromJSON(shapes_filename)

  id_oid <- js[['_id']]
  js[['_id']] <- NULL

  df <- as.data.frame(matrix(unlist(js, recursive = T), ncol = 8, byrow = F))
  colnames(df) <- names(js)

  df <- df %>%
     as_tibble %>%
     mutate(global_stepid = as.numeric(global_stepid), 
         group_stepid = as.numeric(group_stepid),
         ncols = as.numeric(ncols),
         nrows = as.numeric(nrows))
  return(df)
}

machines_steps <- map(shapes_files, read_prep_json)


outcomes_below_resolution_limit <- read_csv(outcomes_below_resolution_limit_file, 
col_types = cols(
  row_id = col_integer(),
  outcome = col_character()
))

```

# Read and prep predictors

```{r}
get_predictors_steps <- function(df) {
  
  result <- df %>% 
    filter(module %in% c("Preprocessing","Preprocessing_encoding")) %>%
    filter(matrix == "Predictors") %>%
    arrange(global_stepid) %>%
    select(step, nrows, ncols) %>%
    mutate(diff_cols = ncols - lag(ncols),
           diff_rows = nrows - lag(nrows))
  return(result)
}

predictors_steps_list <- map(machines_steps, get_predictors_steps)

if (all(map_lgl(predictors_steps_list, identical, y = predictors_steps_list[[1]]))) {
  print("As expected: predictors steps from all machines are identical.")  
} else {
  stop("ERROR: predictors steps from all machines are not identical.") 
}

# if we are here all predictors_steps are the same so we focus on just one
predictors_steps <- predictors_steps_list[[1]]
```


# Read and prep outcomes 

```{r}
get_outcome_steps <- function(df) {
  result <- df %>% 
    filter(module == "Preprocessing") %>%
    filter(matrix == "Outcomes") %>%
    arrange(global_stepid) %>%
    select(step, global_stepid, nrows, ncols) %>%
    mutate(diff_cols = ncols - lag(ncols), 
           diff_rows = nrows - lag(nrows))
  return(result)
}

outcome_steps <- map(machines_steps, get_outcome_steps)

# this combines all the tibbles from the list into 1
outcome_steps_all_machines <- map_dfr(outcome_steps, bind_rows, .id = "machine")

# convert step to factor to help preserve order in group_by statements later
outcome_steps_all_machines$step <- as_factor(outcome_steps_all_machines$step)

###
# begin checks
# except for a few steps, diff_cols should be <= 0
subset_steps <- outcome_steps_all_machines %>%
  filter(!step %in% c("Loading OUTCOMES", "Computing scales, variables with units standardized, variables with units combined predictors and OUTCOMES")) 

if ((all(subset_steps$diff_cols <= 0))) {
  print("As expected: except for known exceptions, diff_cols <= 0")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: something unexpected happened in outcome checks.")
}
rm(subset_steps)

# end checks
###

# This prints out the full list of steps across machines
# for manual skim
kable(outcome_steps_all_machines)
```

# Numbers for outcome flowchart

```{r}

# This chunk creates and combines the numbers for the final STROBE flowchart

# Number of variables in FFCWS year 15 public data
if (outcome_steps_all_machines %>% 
  filter(step == "Loading OUTCOMES") %>% 
  select(ncols) %>% 
  n_distinct() != 1) {
  stop("ERROR: the number of initial outcomes is different across machines")
} else {  
  print("As expected: the number of initial outcomes is same across machines")
}

n_outcomes_initial <- outcome_steps_all_machines %>% 
  filter(step == "Loading OUTCOMES") %>%
  filter(machine == 1) %>% # 1 is arbitrary but OK because they are all the same
  pull(ncols) 

# Check that Recode2to0 does not change number of cols or rows
if (all(outcome_steps_all_machines %>% filter(step == "Recode2to0") %>% select(diff_cols, diff_rows) == 0)) {
  print("As expected: Recode2to0 does not change the number of rows or columns on any machine")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: Recode2to0 changes the number of rows or columns on 1 or more machine")
}

# Aggregate the number of variables dropped at several steps across machines
steps_to_aggregate <- c(
  "Removing outcomes NOT of vartype ", 
  "Removing outcomes with min cities < ",
  "Removing skipped outcomes",
  "Removing month outcomes", 
  "Removing weights from outcomes", 
  "Removing paradata from outcomes", 
  "Removing outcomes with warning codes ",
  "Removing outcomes of concept Standardized_Units",
  "Removing outcomes of concept Unstandardized_Units",
  "Removing outcomes of concept Combined_Units",
  "Removing outcomes of concept Uncombined_Units",
  "Removing outcomes of concept Scales_Inputs_That_Should_Not_Be_Used_Raw",
  "Removing outcomes of concept Duplicate_Outcomes",
  "Removing outcomes of concept Outcomes_Dropped_For_Ethical_Reasons",
  "Removing outcomes where the non-missing values are all same ",
  "Removing outcomes where the number of non") # this last one needs to avoid "-" for some reason

num_steps_to_aggregate <- length(steps_to_aggregate)

aggregated_steps <- outcome_steps_all_machines %>%
  filter(str_detect(step, paste(steps_to_aggregate, collapse = "|"))) %>% 
  group_by(step) %>%
  summarize(total = sum(diff_cols))

if (nrow(aggregated_steps) != num_steps_to_aggregate) stop("ERROR: problem with aggregated_steps")
  
# get total number of outcomes included
final_step <- "Removing outcomes where the number of non" # this has to be set manually for now

n_outcomes_included <- outcome_steps_all_machines %>%
  filter(str_detect(step, final_step)) %>%
  summarize(count = sum(ncols)) %>%
  pull()
  
print(paste("Variables in FFCWS public data year 15:", n_outcomes_initial))
kable(aggregated_steps)


# calculate number of outcomes removed in post-processing
if (any(is.na(outcomes_below_resolution_limit$row_id))) {
  n_outcomes_below_resolution_limit <- 0 
  # if we are here we expect that this file will have only 1 row
  if (nrow(outcomes_below_resolution_limit) >  1) stop("ERROR: unexpected outcomes_below_resolution_limit")
} else {
  n_outcomes_below_resolution_limit <- nrow(outcomes_below_resolution_limit)
}

print(paste("Final number of outcomes after pre-processing:", n_outcomes_included))
print(paste("Number of outcomes removed in post-processing because of resolution limit (zero variance in one or more folds):", n_outcomes_below_resolution_limit))
# There are 3 outcomes we remove in analysis code because they have imputation with data from earlier waves.
outcomes_with_imputation_from_earlier_waves <- 3 
print(paste("Number of outcomes removed due to imputation from earlier waves:", outcomes_with_imputation_from_earlier_waves))
print(paste("Final number of outcomes in analysis:", n_outcomes_included 
            - n_outcomes_below_resolution_limit
            - outcomes_with_imputation_from_earlier_waves))

# Note: We decided not to standardize or combine any outcomes due to concerns about doing so accurately with a high-throughput approach.
# Therefore, the rows for "Standardized_Units" and "Combined_Units" are not applicable for outcomes. 
# The rows for "Unstandardized_Units" and "Uncombined_Units" are still applicable for outcomes, 
# because we dropped outcomes where unit standardization or unit combination would have been necessary.
# For features (see below), standardized, combined, unstandardized, and uncombined are all still applicable, 
# because we did conduct unit standardization and unit combination for features.

# Note: "Removing month outcomes" is no longer relevant because unit standardization/combination code superseded our process for handling month outcomes.
# However, "Removing predictors of concept Calendar_Features" is still applicable (see the output for the features chart below).
```

# Cross-file information

Sometimes information for the predictors flowchart comes in part from the outcomes flowchart and vice-versa.

This is correct, but some of this is inelegant and not robust. If steps in pre-processing get re-ordered, our process for determining the numbers in the flowcharts may need to be refactored.  

```{r}
# How many birth - year 9 variables are in FFCWS data?
# predictors reads complete FFCWS file (birth - year 15)
# outcomes reads FFCWS just year 15
# to figure out number of variables in birth - year 9 we need to compare

variables_b_15 <- predictors_steps %>%
  filter(step == "Loading PREDICTORS") %>%
  pull(ncols)

variables_15 <- outcome_steps_all_machines %>% 
  filter(step == "Loading OUTCOMES") %>%
  filter(machine == 1) %>% # 1 is arbitrary but OK because they are all the same
  pull(ncols) 

variables_b_9 <- variables_b_15 - variables_15

print("THE NEXT INFO GOES IN OUTCOMES FLOWCHART")
print(paste("Number of variables in year 15 main data file (before preprocessing):", variables_15))

print("THE NEXT INFO GOES IN PREDICTORS FLOWCHART")
print(paste("Number of variables in years birth - 9 main data file (before preprocessing):", variables_b_9))
###
```


```{r}
# How many of the scales, unit standardized variables and unit combined variables are age 15 and how many are birth - age 9?
results <- outcome_steps_all_machines %>%
  filter(machine == 1) %>%
  filter(step %in% c("Computing scales, variables with units standardized, variables with units combined predictors and OUTCOMES", "Removing outcomes that are not in ['Year 15']"))  

created_scales_standardized_vars_total <- results %>%
  filter(step == "Computing scales, variables with units standardized, variables with units combined predictors and OUTCOMES") %>%
  pull(diff_cols)

created_scales_standardized_vars_b_9 <- results %>%
  filter(step == "Removing outcomes that are not in ['Year 15']") %>%
  pull(diff_cols) %>%
  abs()

created_scales_standardized_vars_15 <- created_scales_standardized_vars_total - created_scales_standardized_vars_b_9 

print(paste("Created scales, unit standardized variables, unit combined variables, and FFC outcomes (TOTAL):", created_scales_standardized_vars_total))

print("THE NEXT INFO GOES IN OUTCOMES FLOWCHART")
# Note: We created 2 FFC outcomes that were not part of the official scales: k6_scale_GPA and p6_scale_eviction.
number_of_FFC_outcomes_created_that_are_not_official_scales <- 2
print(paste("Created scale outcomes from official FFCWS documentation:", created_scales_standardized_vars_15 - number_of_FFC_outcomes_created_that_are_not_official_scales))
print(paste("Created FFC outcomes that are not scales (hard-coded value):", number_of_FFC_outcomes_created_that_are_not_official_scales))

rm(results)  

### For the features flowchart, create a more detailed breakdown of scales vs. unit standardization vs. unit combination ###

# Read parsable scales instructions
parsable_scales_instructions <- read_csv(
  here::here(
    "data",
    "dataset",
    "fragile-families",
    "parsable_scales_instructions.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Filter to birth-9 and exclude intermediate variables used in calculations
features_created_from_parsable_instructions <- parsable_scales_instructions %>%
  filter(metadata_wave != "Year 15") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(metadata_new_name, "intermediate"))

# Count number of scales, unit standardized variables, and unit combined variables
feature_creation_counts <- features_created_from_parsable_instructions %>%
  mutate(
    type_of_variable_creation = case_when(
      str_detect(metadata_new_name, "scale") ~ "scale",
      str_detect(metadata_new_name, "unst") ~ "unit standardization",
      str_detect(metadata_new_name, "uncomb") ~ "unit combination",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    type_of_variable_creation = factor(
      type_of_variable_creation,
      levels = c(
        "scale",
        "unit standardization",
        "unit combination",
        "other"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(type_of_variable_creation) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

print("THE FOLLOWING TABLE CONTAINS FEATURE CREATION COUNTS FOR THE FEATURES FLOWCHART:")
feature_creation_counts

# Quality control check
n_created_features <- feature_creation_counts %>%
  filter(type_of_variable_creation %in% c(
    "scale",
    "unit standardization",
    "unit combination"
  )) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(count)) %>%
  pull(total)

if (n_created_features != created_scales_standardized_vars_b_9) {
  stop("ERROR: feature creation counts do not match matrix-shape tracking")
}
###
```

```{r}
# Quality control check for year-15 predictor removal
# Number of predictors dropped because they are in year 15 should be the number of year 15 variables + the number of created scales and standardized vars for age 15.
 
 removed_predictors_15 <- predictors_steps %>%
   filter(str_detect(step, "Removing predictors that are not in")) %>%
   pull(diff_cols) %>%
   abs()
 
 if (removed_predictors_15 != (created_scales_standardized_vars_15 + variables_15)) {
   print(paste("removed_predictors_15:", removed_predictors_15))
   print(paste("created_scales_standardized_vars_15:", created_scales_standardized_vars_15))
   print(paste("variables_15:", variables_15))
   stop("ERROR: things don't add up")
 }
```
